title: Accessibility and Mobile Readability
notes: Fixed the login password field accessibility name so the password visibility control no longer interferes with the field label.
Added automatic accessible labels and hover titles for icon-only actions such as edit, delete, close, copy, refresh and preview.
Reworked the mobile Calendar into a vertical day-by-day agenda so phone users no longer need to scroll across a desktop-width week board.
Increased compact text and touch targets across field tickets, jobs, dispatch, customer management and the client portal for clearer everyday use.
Extended production browser QA timeouts so the full live role and mobile route matrix can complete reliably.
